messages:
Anna: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands — I want this thread to capture any specific asks about prioritization and our competitive positioning so leadership can respond.
Jai (VP Product): Thanks — a couple quick ones already. Is the primary product priority this quarter Dedicated capacity improvements or Private (VPC/on‑prem) onboarding flow? Which gets the larger eng ramp?
Maya: +1 from infra — Dedicated autoscaling work is already mid-sprint but Private onboarding has legal/security blockers flagged by a couple pilots.
Anna: Short answer: Dedicated gets the larger headcount this quarter. Rationale: higher near-term ARR and fewer compliance tails. Private stays prioritized for a focused feature team to unblock pilots and KMS/HSM integrations.
Rob: For sales folks: can we get a crisp 2‑sentence positioning to use on calls vs. major cloud vendors? Customers ask why not just use cloud-managed endpoints.
Jai (VP Product): Draft: "Redwood focuses on predictable, production-grade serving with developer-first controls — you get the same API across hosted, reserved, and private deployments plus tooling to drive unit economics down. We optimize for latency, cost, and observable regressions rather than raw model access." Thoughts?
Lina: That helps — can we include a line about rollouts/fallbacks? Customers care about graceful degradation.
Jai (VP Product): Update: add a short clause: "Includes rollout controls and automatic fallbacks to keep apps live under load or regional failures."
Maya: Ops question: how are we communicating fallback behavior to customers? Is this opt-in or default? Will it impact data region guarantees?
Anna: Default for hosted is to allow compatible fallbacks within region unless customer pins versions or requests strict isolation. For Dedicated/Private we respect pins and region rules — we'll make this explicit in the SLA and onboarding checklist.
Rob: Sales follow-up: any objections to a one‑pager kara to hand prospects? I can draft and loop in marketing.
Lina: Go for it — flag the legal bits for Private deployments.
DeployBot: deploy-notify: Canary rollout started: dedicated-autoscale/v2 -> 3 nodes (ci 1582)
Maya: Noted, thanks @DeployBot. If the canary looks good, can we shift two engs to Private onboarding next week?
Anna: Yes — if metrics hold after canary (esp. p95 latency and error budget) we reassign two engineers Monday. Thanks everyone — keep questions here and we’ll capture action items in the roadmap doc. :thumbsup:
